svg.text: Everything wrapped around the LLM, and where each piece lives in the code.
Provides what the model knows beyond its weights.
System prompt v1: 5 rules (numbers only from tools, 2026 scope, no
User message, 1-2000 chars; no prior turns
Ground truth arrives only as tool results: 15 races of results +
laps CSVs and the Sepang qualifying grid
Every result carries a source field (model or CSV path)
Lets the LLM read the prediction model; it can never change
Pure functions over the f1_core Predictor (XGBoost + SHAP),
Pydantic result schemas, numbers rounded to 4 dp
Stores past interactions, preferences and long-term knowledge.
Stateless: every /chat call runs the agent with no message
session_id (one per browser tab) only groups Langfuse
Nothing persisted: no user preferences, no conversation
Users must restate context in follow-ups
Decides the flow and keeps one request bounded.
Pydantic AI agent loop: LLM picks a tool, gets the result,
Runner streams text, tool calls, tool results and retries to the
90 s timeout, retries=2; client disconnect cancels the LLM call
Model picked per request from an OpenRouter allow-list
Measures accuracy, grounding and scope, offline and live.
correctness, robustness, scope; dev / held-out split
Deterministic evaluators; ground truth recomputed from live
Failure-mode taxonomy filled only from inspected traces
Live: Langfuse tracing plus a thumbs up/down score per
pytest with a scripted fake LLM
Keeps answers safe, grounded and on topic.
Bad driver / round / grid values raise ModelRetry listing
Grounding check: any % or decimal not found in a tool
result triggers one retry, then is flagged unverified
Hard caps: 8 tool calls and 90 s, with canned fallback
Prompt scope rule declines anything outside the 2026
Feedback nudge highlights risky answers in the UI
Based on ai_assistant/backend as of the Sepang (round 16) build. Dashed card = component the harness does not have yet.
